name: hr_bench_cross_100
description: hr_bench_cross_100 is a small curated benchmark of 100 examples intended to evaluate model response quality across varied prompts via human ratings. It is designed for cross-system comparison and measuring relative preference or quality of outputs rather than large-scale automated benchmarking. The dataset is useful for quick human-evaluated checks of model behavior on a compact set of items.
reputation: Small-scale dataset with limited adoption, typically used for quick human-evaluation comparisons rather than broad benchmarking.
